defect: Six project-control documents and the phasewise index state "No models were loaded or run in this evaluation". That sentence is FALSE for the Phase25E EVALUATION phase: the frozen final Phase25D router checkpoint was loaded and run ONCE, outcome-blind, over the 4957 ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT feature rows to derive the DEV deployment-score ranking and the per-budget rank boundaries/tau. The sentence is only true of the earlier Phase25E SPECIFICATION-FREEZE phase.

phase25e_final_router_dev_calibration.js.role: This artifact RECORDS the single frozen-router DEV forward.

phase25e_no_execution_audit.json.role: This artifact is scoped to the Phase25E SPECIFICATION-FREEZE phase ONLY (classification PHASE25E_PRE_EXECUTION_RESOURCE_GATE_SPECIFICATION_FREEZE). Its zero-forward counts describe the spec phase, NOT the later policy evaluation.

scope_disambiguation.phase25e_specification_freeze: no model load / no forward (design + membership freeze only)
scope_disambiguation.phase25e_policy_evaluation: exactly one frozen-router forward over the 4957 DEV rows; no global forward; no refiner forward; no training

reconciled_wording: Phase25E loaded the frozen final benefit-router checkpoint once and ran a single outcome-blind forward pass over the 4,957 ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT feature rows to fix the DEV deployment-score ranking and per-budget rank boundaries. No global segmentation model was re-run, no regional refiner was run, no model was trained, no lambda was selected, and the C9 post-safety comparator was not evaluated. ROUTER_HOLDOUT, VAL808 and TEST were never read.
